title: 648. The Fall of the Incas: Battle for the Sacred City (Part 5)

sentences.en: The Incas, my ancestors, ruled from Chile to Quito, treating their vassals as their own children.
sentences.zh: 我的祖先印加人，曾统治着从智利到基多的广袤土地，他们视臣民如己出。

sentences.en: They did not steal, and killed only when it served justice.
sentences.zh: 他们从不偷窃，只有在伸张正义时才会杀戮。

sentences.en: They kept order and reason in the provinces.
sentences.zh: 他们在各省维持着秩序与理性。

sentences.en: But now the bearded ones have entered our land.
sentences.zh: 但现在，那些长胡子的人闯入了我们的土地。

sentences.en: They preach one thing and do another.
sentences.zh: 他们言行不一，口是心非。

sentences.en: They have no fear of God and no shame.
sentences.zh: 他们既无敬畏之心，也无羞耻之感。

sentences.en: They treat us like dogs.
sentences.zh: 他们像对待狗一样对待我们。

sentences.en: Their greed is such that there is no temple they have not plundered.
sentences.zh: 他们贪婪成性，所到之处，无庙不掠。

sentences.en: In fact, if all the snow turned to gold and silver, it would not satisfy them.
sentences.zh: 事实上，即便把所有的雪都变成金银，也无法满足他们。

sentences.en: They keep our sisters as their concubines, behaving like animals.
sentences.zh: 他们把我们的姐妹当作妾室，行径如同禽兽。

sentences.en: They want to divide up all the provinces, giving one to each so that they can loot them.
sentences.zh: 他们想要瓜分所有的省份，每人分一块，好让他们肆意劫掠。

sentences.en: Their goal is to see us so downtrodden, so enslaved, that we will be fit only to find them precious metals.
sentences.zh: 他们的目标是让我们变得卑微、沦为奴隶，好让我们只配为他们寻找贵金属。

sentences.en: And to give them our women.
sentences.zh: 还要把我们的女人献给他们。

sentences.en: Which Spaniard have we injured?
sentences.zh: 我们伤害过哪位西班牙人吗？

sentences.en: That they should make such cruel war on us with these horses and weapons of iron.
sentences.zh: 竟让他们用这些马匹和铁制武器对我们发动如此残酷的战争。

sentences.en: I believe it would not be just or honourable for us to consent to this.
sentences.zh: 我认为，如果我们同意这一点，既不公正也不光彩。

sentences.en: So let us strive with all our might to kill these cruel enemies, or die in the attempt.
sentences.zh: 所以，让我们竭尽全力去杀死这些残暴的敌人，或者在尝试中英勇牺牲。

sentences.en: So that was Manco, Emperor of the Incas, addressing a secret gathering of his kinsmen and supporters
sentences.zh: 以上就是印加皇帝曼科在1535年秋天于库斯科秘密召集族人和支持者时的演讲，

sentences.en: in Cusco in the autumn of 1535, offering a perspective there on Spanish rule that you have to say, I mean, is not unjustified.
sentences.zh: 他在那里提出的关于西班牙统治的观点，你不得不说，并非毫无道理。

sentences.en: Perhaps slightly whitewashing the amiability of the Incan regime.
sentences.zh: 或许稍微美化了印加政权的温和程度。

sentences.en: But, you know, needs muSt.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，形势所迫嘛。

sentences.en: And we are three years now into the conquest of the Incas.
sentences.zh: 我们征服印加已经三年了。

sentences.en: And now, Dominic, you have written the story is approaching its thrilling climax.
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，你写的故事现在正接近激动人心的高潮。

sentences.en: I mean, it's probably not that thrilling for the Incas, is it?
sentences.zh: 我是说，这对印加人来说可能并不怎么激动人心，对吧？

sentences.en: No, it's not that thrilling.
sentences.zh: 不，确实没那么激动人心。

sentences.en: Big spoiler alert.
sentences.zh: 剧透预警。

sentences.en: Lots of people are going to die in the next two episodes.
sentences.zh: 接下来的两集里会有很多人死去。

sentences.en: I mean, that's the nature of history.
sentences.zh: 这就是历史的本质。

sentences.en: But they die in exciting ways in these episodes.
sentences.zh: 但在这些剧集中，他们的死法很刺激。

sentences.en: So that makes it particularly thrilling.
sentences.zh: 所以这让它显得格外惊心动魄。

sentences.en: Along with some beard shaving and guava fruit throwing, which is an unexpected angle.
sentences.zh: 还有刮胡子和扔番石榴的桥段，这真是一个意想不到的角度。

sentences.en: Yes, definitely look forward to the throwing of guava fruit.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对期待扔番石榴的场面。

sentences.en: And also, if you're a fan of garrotting, this is not quite at the Lope de Gire level of garrotting, but it's up there.
sentences.zh: 而且，如果你是绞刑爱好者，虽然这还没达到洛佩·德·吉雷那种绞刑的水平，但也相差无几了。

sentences.en: And Dominic, fair to say that guava fruit chucking actually isn't going to be the worst of it.
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，公平地说，扔番石榴其实还不是最糟糕的部分。

sentences.en: So, you know, if you like torture, listen on.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你喜欢看折磨人的戏码，那就继续听吧。

sentences.en: If you don't, or you've got children with you, just perhaps, you know.
sentences.zh: 如果你不喜欢，或者身边有孩子，那可能……

sentences.en: Reign it in a bit.
sentences.zh: 稍微收敛一点。

sentences.en: So, let's set the scene.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们来交代一下背景。

sentences.en: Francisco Pizarro and his fellow conquistadors had sailed down the Pacific coast from Panama.
sentences.zh: 弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗和他的征服者同伙从巴拿马沿太平洋海岸航行而来。

sentences.en: They'd marched inland.
sentences.zh: 他们向内陆进军。

sentences.en: They'd captured and killed the emperor Atahualpa.
sentences.zh: 他们俘虏并杀害了皇帝阿塔瓦尔帕。

sentences.en: They'd pocketed the biggest ransom in history.
sentences.zh: 他们捞到了历史上最大的一笔赎金。

sentences.en: Last week, we heard how they marched on the capital, Cusco.
sentences.zh: 上周，我们听说了他们是如何向首都库斯科进军的。

sentences.en: They installed a puppet emperor in this chap, Manco, then very young.
sentences.zh: 他们扶持了当时还很年轻的曼科作为傀儡皇帝。

sentences.en: And they crushed opposition in the northern part of the empire in what's now Ecuador.
sentences.zh: 他们镇压了帝国北部（即现在的厄瓜多尔）的反对势力。

sentences.en: But in today's episode, they will be facing their biggest challenge yet.
sentences.zh: 但在今天的节目中，他们将面临迄今为止最大的挑战。

sentences.en: So, an uprising led by Manco and a street-by-street, Stalingrad-style battle for control of the capital, Cusco.
sentences.zh: 一场由曼科领导的起义，以及一场为了争夺首都库斯科控制权而进行的巷战，就像斯大林格勒保卫战那样。

sentences.en: So, it's a very dramatic story.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一个非常戏剧性的故事。

sentences.en: And let's start with the man who you ventriloquised so admirably, Tom, Manco.
sentences.zh: 让我们从你刚才模仿得惟妙惟肖的那个人开始吧，汤姆，曼科。

sentences.en: A noble man.
sentences.zh: 一位高尚的人。

sentences.en: I feel I conveyed the nobility.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我传达出了那种高贵感。

sentences.en: You totally did.
sentences.zh: 你确实做到了。

sentences.en: You totally did.
sentences.zh: 你确实做到了。

sentences.en: I think the Spanish themselves, the Spanish chroniclers and memoirists who wrote about
sentences.zh: 我认为西班牙人自己，那些在16世纪中叶撰写关于曼科回忆录的西班牙编年史家，

sentences.en: Manco in the middle of the 16th century, absolutely saw him as a noble character, even as a heroic character, actually.
sentences.zh: 绝对把他视为一个高尚的人物，甚至实际上是一个英雄人物。

sentences.en: A worthy adversary.
sentences.zh: 一个值得尊敬的对手。

sentences.en: A worthy adversary.
sentences.zh: 一个值得尊敬的对手。

sentences.en: So, we know very little about him before Pizarro met him outside Cusco and basically adopted him as his puppet.
sentences.zh: 所以，在皮萨罗在库斯科城外遇见他并基本上把他收为傀儡之前，我们对他知之甚少。

sentences.en: So, he was a brother of Huascar, the defeated claimant in the Inca Civil War.
sentences.zh: 他是瓦斯卡尔的兄弟，也就是印加内战中失败的王位争夺者。

sentences.en: He's been on the run from Atahualpa's men.
sentences.zh: 他一直在躲避阿塔瓦尔帕手下的追捕。

sentences.en: He's probably in his late teens when he meets Pizarro.
sentences.zh: 他遇见皮萨罗时可能才十几岁。

sentences.en: When they arrived in Cusco in November 1533, he was greeted as a liberator.
sentences.zh: 当他们于1533年11月抵达库斯科时，他被当作解放者受到欢迎。

sentences.en: He was clearly popular with the crowds.
sentences.zh: 他显然很受民众爱戴。

sentences.en: There's no hint of a rising against him or resentment.
sentences.zh: 没有任何迹象表明有人反抗他或对他心怀不满。

sentences.en: And actually, at first, all went very well.
sentences.zh: 事实上，起初一切都非常顺利。

sentences.en: Six months later, June 1534, Pizarro's secretary, Pedro Sancho, wrote that his coronation has proved highly successful.
sentences.zh: 六个月后，即1534年6月，皮萨罗的秘书佩德罗·桑乔写道，他的加冕典礼非常成功。

sentences.en: All the chiefs come to serve him and pay homage to the emperor, by which he means Charles
sentences.zh: 所有的酋长都来侍奉他，并向皇帝（他指的是西班牙的查理五世）表示敬意，

sentences.en: V of Spain, because of him.
sentences.zh: 因为他的缘故。

sentences.en: And actually, the Spanish sent several reports that summer to Spain, saying, we're very pleased with him.
sentences.zh: 事实上，西班牙人那个夏天向西班牙发回了几份报告，说：我们对他非常满意。

sentences.en: He's doing very well.
sentences.zh: 他做得很好。

sentences.en: All is good.
sentences.zh: 一切都好。

sentences.en: However, Manco obviously is facing some pretty formidable challenges.
sentences.zh: 然而，曼科显然正面临着一些相当严峻的挑战。

sentences.en: So, as we've said so many times, the fact that there has been a civil war has left the
sentences.zh: 正如我们多次提到的，内战的事实已经让印加帝国——塔万廷苏尤——陷入了废墟。

sentences.en: Inca Empire, Tawantinsoyo, in ruins.
sentences.zh: 帝国的一些地区，当地的族群试图摆脱印加的统治。

sentences.en: There are parts of the empire where local ethnic groups have tried to throw off Inca rule.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这与他们所说的“视臣民如己出”相矛盾。

sentences.en: I mean, that's contradicting the whole, we treated them like children.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 因为正如我们在第一集所描述的那样，印加人是相当可怕的统治者。

sentences.en: Because the Incas, as we've described in our very first episode, are pretty terrifying overlords.
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果他们愿意，他们会摧毁你的村庄，把你强行迁徙到帝国几百英里外的地方，并强迫你讲他们的语言——克丘亚语。

sentences.en: I mean, they will destroy your village and move you, you know, hundreds of miles across the empire and force you to speak Quechua, their language, you know, if they want to.
sentences.zh: 所以，当地的一些军阀在某些地区夺取了控制权。

sentences.en: So, local kind of warlords have taken control in some areas.
sentences.zh: 人们抛弃了印加的太阳崇拜，转而回归他们古老的神灵等等。

sentences.en: People have thrown off the Inca sun cult and gone back to their old gods and things.
sentences.zh: 正如约翰·赫明在他那本关于秘鲁征服的杰作中所说，曼科必须努力恢复印加的崇拜，接管行政管理权，

sentences.en: And as John Hemming, in his brilliant book about the conquest of Peru, says, Manco had to try to restore the sort of cult of the Inca, to take over control of the administration,
sentences.zh: 确立他作为最高统治者的权威。

sentences.en: to assert his primacy as supreme ruler.
sentences.zh: 他必须重振库斯科的威望。

sentences.en: He had to revive the prestige of Cusco.
sentences.zh: 他必须重振官方宗教的威望，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: He had to revive the prestige of the official religion, all of this kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 现在，西班牙人在某种程度上是这方面的有用盟友。

sentences.en: Now, the Spanish, up to a point, are useful allies in this.
sentences.zh: 他大概把他们看作是这类故事中常见的那样，仅仅是秘鲁现有政治格局中的一个新因素，

sentences.en: He presumably sees them, as so many people do in these sort of stories, as merely a new
sentences.zh: 一个他可以利用和驾驭的因素。

sentences.en: factor in the existing kind of political landscape of Peru, and one that he can harness and use.
sentences.zh: 所以，多米尼克，在这一点上，曼科认为一切都可以像往常一样继续下去。

sentences.en: So, Dominic, at this point, Manco assumes that everything can carry on pretty much as it always has done.
sentences.zh: 他不认为西班牙人从根本上改变了一切。

sentences.en: He doesn't think that the Spanish essentially have changed everything.
sentences.zh: 不，因为我们谈论的是极少数人。

sentences.en: No, because we're talking about very small numbers of people.
sentences.zh: 我是说，在这个十年结束时，西班牙人对自己在新卡斯蒂利亚（他们这样称呼）的人口进行了一次普查。

sentences.en: I mean, at the end of this decade, the Spanish did a census of their own population in New
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是4000人。

sentences.en: Castile, as they called it.
sentences.zh: 所以在这个阶段，我们可能谈论的是这个数字的一半，差不多就是这样。

sentences.en: And we were talking about 4,000 people.
sentences.zh: 我是说，人数很少，对吧？

sentences.en: So, at this stage, we're probably talking about half that, something like that.
sentences.zh: 在一个拥有1200万人口的帝国里，最多2000人，在这个阶段可能只有几百人。

sentences.en: I mean, a tiny number, right?
sentences.zh: 所以，他为什么要往别处想呢？

sentences.en: In an empire of 12 million people, 2,000 maximum, probably hundreds at this stage.
sentences.zh: 这些是他欠下王位的人的精英雇佣兵，但他们不会永远是一个因素。

sentences.en: So, why would he think differently?
sentences.zh: 而且他们的人数可能也不会再多了。

sentences.en: These are elite mercenaries to whom he owes his throne, but they're not going to be a factor forever.
sentences.zh: 当然，在这一点上，他完全彻底地错了。

sentences.en: And there's probably not that many more of them.
sentences.zh: 总之，起初迹象都很好。

sentences.en: And of course, in this, he is completely and utterly wrong.
sentences.zh: 他在库斯科为自己建造了一座新宫殿。

sentences.en: Anyway, at first, the signs are all good.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，我认为与墨西哥相比，西班牙人似乎并不热衷于推行基督教化计划。

sentences.en: He builds himself a new palace in Cusco.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，曼科完全可以自由地继续进行那些确立他作为萨帕·印加（印加皇帝）至高无上地位的宗教仪式。

sentences.en: And interestingly, quite a difference, I think, with Mexico, the Spanish don't seem terribly keen on pushing the program of Christianization.
sentences.zh: 一位名叫克里斯托瓦尔·德·莫利纳的年轻牧师对1535年4月的犁耕节有一段美妙的描述。
zh_words: 克里斯托瓦尔·德·莫利纳

sentences.en: So, you know, Manco is completely free to continue with the religious rituals that enshrine his primacy as the Sapa Inca.
sentences.zh: 这实际上是我们拥有的关于印加宗教节日最好的描述之一。

sentences.en: There's a lovely description by a young priest called Cristobal de Melina of a plowing festival in April 1535.
sentences.zh: 他们在黎明时分把所有的神像从神庙里请出来。

sentences.en: It's one of the best descriptions we have, actually, of an Inca religious festival.
sentences.zh: 库斯科的贵族们穿着昂贵的银色斗篷和束腰外衣，头上戴着闪闪发光的纯金头环。

sentences.en: They bring all the effigies out from the temples at daybreak.
sentences.zh: 他们排成队列，在深沉的寂静中等待太阳升起。

sentences.en: The lords of Cusco wore rich silver cloaks and tunics with shining circlets of fine gold on their heads.
sentences.zh: 当太阳开始升起时，他们开始以宏伟的和谐音调吟唱。

sentences.en: They formed up in a procession and waited in deep silence for the sun to rise.
sentences.zh: 随着太阳继续升起，他们的吟唱声也越来越高昂。

sentences.en: And as the sun began to rise, they began to chant in splendid harmony.
sentences.zh: 他们整天都在吟唱。

sentences.en: And as it continued to rise, they chanted higher.
sentences.zh: 曼科在某种程度上领导着他们。

sentences.en: And all day they chant.
sentences.zh: 然后，据我们所知，当太阳开始下沉时，印第安人对它的离去表现出极大的悲伤，并让他们的声音逐渐消失。

sentences.en: Manco is kind of leading them.
sentences.zh: 当太阳完全消失时，他们做出了这种崇敬的举动，以最深沉的谦卑崇拜它。

sentences.en: And then, we're told, as the sun began to sink, the Indians showed great sadness at its departure and allowed their voices to die away.
sentences.zh: 然后他们都回到了自己的家中，神像和圣物被送回了它们的神龛和神庙。

sentences.en: And as it completely disappears, they make this act of reverence, worshipping it in the deepest humility.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你参与了那个仪式，显然，克里斯托瓦尔·德·莫利纳，你知道，他描写它的方式。
zh_words: 克里斯托瓦尔·德·莫利纳

sentences.en: And then they all went back to their homes and the effigies and relics were returned to their shrines and temples.
sentences.zh: 很尊重，不是吗？

sentences.en: So, if you're part of that ceremony, which clearly, Cristobal de Melina, you know, the way he writes about it.
sentences.zh: 是的，这很尊重，而且他显然觉得这相当感人。

sentences.en: It's respectful, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这是一种和谐与统一的错觉，仿佛世界回到了正轨，仿佛内战后的混乱之后一切都已恢复。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's respectful and he finds it clearly quite moving.
sentences.zh: 但有三条裂痕正在不断扩大。

sentences.en: There's this illusion of harmony and unity, that the world is back on its axis, that everything has been restored after the chaos of the civil war.
sentences.zh: 第一条是在西班牙人和印加人之间。

sentences.en: But there are three fracture lines that are widening all the time.
sentences.zh: 第二条是在印加人自己之间。

sentences.en: So, the first is between the Spanish and the Incas.
sentences.zh: 第三条是在西班牙人自己之间。

sentences.en: The second is among the Incas themselves.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是三者中最危险的一条。

sentences.en: And the third is among the Spaniards themselves.
sentences.zh: 那么，如果我们从西班牙人和印加人开始说起。

sentences.en: And that's arguably the most dangerous of the three.
sentences.zh: 上次结束时，我们谈到了西班牙人是如何开始表现得非常恶劣的。

sentences.en: So, if we start with the Spanish and the Incas.
sentences.zh: 他们开始掠夺金银。

sentences.en: When we ended last time, we were talking about how the Spanish were starting to behave very badly.
sentences.zh: 他们蔑视祭司。

sentences.en: They're starting to loot gold and silver.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，一件非常重要的事情是，皮萨罗开始向他的征服者同伙分配地产，即土地所有权。

sentences.en: They're treating the priests with contempt.
sentences.zh: 这些就是后来成为西班牙秘鲁殖民世界特征的“监护征赋制”。

sentences.en: And, you know, a really big thing, Pizarro is starting to distribute estates, landed estates to his fellow conquistadors.
sentences.zh: 他遇到了一个大问题，不是吗？

sentences.en: These are the encomiendas that become such a feature of kind of the settler colonial world of Spanish Peru.
sentences.zh: 随着越来越多的人从西班牙来到这里，他们也想要监护征赋权。

sentences.en: And he's got a big problem, hasn't he?
sentences.zh: 这对他维持与印加人和平的能力构成了越来越大的压力。

sentences.en: That as more and more people come from Spain, so they want encomiendas as well.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And that is an increasing source of pressure on his ability to maintain peace with the
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是他们想要监护征赋权。

sentences.en: Incas.
sentences.zh: 而是他们到达后以为会得到大量的黄金。

sentences.en: Dead right.
sentences.zh: 结果他们到了却发现没有黄金，因为黄金已经被分光了。

sentences.en: It's not just they want encomiendas.
sentences.zh: 所以他们说，好吧，如果我得不到黄金，你最好给我一些土地和一些在土地上干活的人。

sentences.en: It's that they arrive and they think they're going to get loads of gold.
sentences.zh: 所以皮萨罗基本上是在分发越来越多的土地，并无视西班牙王室官员的要求。

sentences.en: And they arrive and there's no gold because it's been given out.
sentences.zh: 请问，你能停止分发你不拥有的土地吗？

sentences.en: And so they say, well, if I can't have any gold, you better give me some land and somebody to work on the land.
sentences.zh: 他还有其他花招，就是把他们打发到丛林里或偏远的沙漠里去寻找失落的黄金之城。

sentences.en: And so Pizarro is basically giving away more and more and ignoring requests from the court in Spain for royal officials.
sentences.zh: 一个大特点。

sentences.en: Please, will you stop distributing land that you don't own?
sentences.zh: 一个将持续下去的大特点。

sentences.en: And his other wheezes to send them off into the jungle or into kind of remote deserts to go looking for lost cities with gold.
sentences.zh: 所以你开始收到来自当地城镇和村庄的报告，说人们不再把西班牙人视为进入内战混乱局面的解放者。

sentences.en: A big feature.
sentences.zh: 他们把他们视为彻头彻尾的占领者。

sentences.en: A big feature that will carry on.
sentences.zh: 正如军事占领中常见的那样，一个非常关键的断层线是占领者如何对待当地妇女。

sentences.en: So you start to get reports that from local towns and villages that people no longer see the Spanish as the liberators who've entered the chaos of the Civil War.
sentences.zh: 所以就像在墨西哥一样，我们上周在节目中请到了佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多，不是吗？

sentences.en: They see them as occupiers in their own right.
sentences.zh: 他们没有偷窃，只有在伸张正义时才会杀戮。

sentences.en: And as so often with occupations, military occupations, a really key fault line is how the occupiers treat the local women.
sentences.zh: 他们维持着秩序与理性。

sentences.en: So as in Mexico, we had Pedro de Alvarado on the show last week, didn't we?
sentences.zh: 但现在，那些长胡子的人闯入了我们的土地。

sentences.en: An old associate of the rest is history.
sentences.zh: 关于其余人的旧交情，历史自有定论。

sentences.en: And you mentioned that he had got this wife, I think she was called Donna Luisa, wasn't she?
sentences.zh: 你提到他娶了位妻子，我想她叫唐娜·路易莎，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In Mexico, who is buried with him in the cathedral in Guatemala.
sentences.zh: 在墨西哥，她和谁一起葬在危地马拉的大教堂里。

sentences.en: And he became the governor of Guatemala.
sentences.zh: 后来他成了危地马拉的总督。

sentences.en: This is a very standard thing, not becoming the governor, but for the Spanish to take local wives, as they call them, actually kind of mistresses or concubines.
sentences.zh: 这其实是很普遍的事，不是说当总督，而是西班牙人娶当地女子为妻，或者说，其实就是纳妾或蓄婢。

sentences.en: So Atahualpa had already given Pizarro a half-sister of his called Quispe Cusi, who was 18 years old.
sentences.zh: 当时阿塔瓦尔帕已经把他的同父异母妹妹基斯佩·库西送给了皮萨罗，她当时才18岁。

sentences.en: The Spanish called her Inés.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人叫她伊内斯。

sentences.en: Pizarro nicknamed her Pispita, which is a water thrush from his native Extremadura.
sentences.zh: 皮萨罗给她起了个绰号叫“皮斯皮塔”，这是他家乡埃斯特雷马杜拉的一种水鸫鸟。

sentences.en: It's a sweet name.
sentences.zh: 是个很可爱的名字。

sentences.en: And he actually treated her pretty well.
sentences.zh: 而且他确实对她相当不错。

sentences.en: He called her his wife.
sentences.zh: 他称她为自己的妻子。

sentences.en: She would dine with him and his captains.
sentences.zh: 她会和他以及他的队长们一起用餐。

sentences.en: She had two children by him.
sentences.zh: 她为他生了两个孩子。

sentences.en: Eventually, he got bored of her, and he married her off to another conquistador called Francisco de Ampuero.
sentences.zh: 后来，他厌倦了她，就把她嫁给了另一位征服者，弗朗西斯科·德·安普埃罗。
zh_words: 弗朗西斯科·德·安普埃罗

sentences.en: And actually, their descendants, the Ampuero's, ended up being one of Peru's most powerful political families.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们的后代安普埃罗家族，最终成为了秘鲁最有权势的政治家族之一。

sentences.en: Because in Incan society, women do play kind of a key role as power brokers, as people who influence the policy of their husbands and their families.
sentences.zh: 因为在印加社会中，女性确实扮演着关键的权力掮客角色，她们能影响丈夫和家族的决策。

sentences.en: And, you know, with Alvarado or with Pizarro or whoever, there is a sense that when the marriage works, it's to the benefit of both sides.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，无论是阿尔瓦拉多还是皮萨罗，或者其他人，人们总觉得当婚姻运作良好时，对双方都有利。

sentences.en: And throughout this story, I mean, we'll see there are Incan women or indeed women from other peoples who stick by the Spaniards.
sentences.zh: 纵观整个故事，我们会看到，确实有印加女性，或者其他民族的女性，一直追随西班牙人。

sentences.en: So that is true, but I don't think we should downgrade the element of coercion that is often there.
sentences.zh: 这确实是真的，但我觉得我们不应低估其中往往存在的胁迫因素。

sentences.en: Of course not.
sentences.zh: 当然不会。

sentences.en: You know, as we will see, there is incredible violence as well.
sentences.zh: 你知道，正如我们将要看到的，其中也存在令人难以置信的暴力。

sentences.en: But for the Spaniards, it is an option that many of these women are very shrewd political players.
sentences.zh: 但对西班牙人来说，他们认为许多女性是精明的政治博弈者，这是一种选择。

sentences.en: Yes, that's absolutely true.
sentences.zh: 是的，这绝对是真的。

sentences.en: That's absolutely fair.
sentences.zh: 这绝对公允。

sentences.en: But to give another example, Diego de Almagro, who is Pizarro's business partner, his very disputatious and resentful business partner.
sentences.zh: 但再举个例子，迭戈·德·阿尔马格罗，他是皮萨罗的商业伙伴，一个非常爱争辩且心怀怨恨的商业伙伴。

sentences.en: Almagro married another daughter of Juena Capac, the old emperor.
sentences.zh: 阿尔马格罗娶了老皇帝瓦伊纳·卡帕克的另一个女儿。

sentences.en: So this is Manco's sister, Marca Chimbo.
sentences.zh: 也就是曼科的姐妹，马尔卡·钦博。

sentences.en: She's very rich.
sentences.zh: 她非常富有。

sentences.en: She's clearly very impressive.
sentences.zh: 她显然非常令人钦佩。

sentences.en: She's one of these people you're talking about, Tom.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，她就是你所说的那类人。

sentences.en: The Spanish sources say she would have inherited the Inca empire if she had been a man.
sentences.zh: 西班牙史料记载，如果她是男儿身，她本可以继承印加帝国。

sentences.en: But Almagro treats her very badly.
sentences.zh: 但阿尔马格罗对她非常恶劣。

sentences.en: She was repeatedly dishonored, for she was very pretty and of a gentle nature, and she caught the pox.
sentences.zh: 她屡遭羞辱，因为她长得很漂亮，性格温和，而且还染上了天花。

sentences.en: So, I mean, who knows what's going on there, but there's nothing good, I would say.
sentences.zh: 所以，谁知道那里发生了什么，但我敢说，绝不是什么好事。

sentences.en: The rank and file, too, insist on taking local women as mistresses.
sentences.zh: 普通士兵也坚持要纳当地女子为妾。

sentences.en: Now, some sources say this was consensual.
sentences.zh: 有些资料说这是你情我愿的。

sentences.en: An Indian woman who proved most attractive to the Spaniards prided herself on the fact.
sentences.zh: 一位对西班牙人极具吸引力的印第安女子以此为荣。

sentences.en: But at the same time, a different source.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，另一份资料却说。

sentences.en: No woman who was good-looking was safe.
sentences.zh: 没有哪个长得好看的女人是安全的。

sentences.en: It was a miracle if she escaped the Spaniards.
sentences.zh: 她能逃过西班牙人的魔爪简直是奇迹。

sentences.en: And you can see how both those things could possibly be true at once.
sentences.zh: 你可以看出这两种说法为何可能同时成立。

sentences.en: The Spaniards might seem prestigious and high status, and so people might be attracted by them.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人可能显得地位显赫，所以人们可能会被他们吸引。

sentences.en: But at the same time, the Spanish are behaving increasingly badly.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，西班牙人的行为却越来越恶劣。

sentences.en: Well, also, I mean, you hope that if you can find one who will protect you, a Spaniard, then you need that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且，如果你能找到一个能保护你的西班牙人，那你确实需要这种保护。

sentences.en: Well, you do need protection because the Spanish, I mean, to give an example of the coercive element, they supposedly had a test, and this is from a Spanish source, I think.
sentences.zh: 没错，你确实需要保护，因为西班牙人——举个胁迫的例子——他们据说有一种测试方法，我想这是出自一份西班牙史料。

sentences.en: They have a test to see if a girl is old enough for them to sleep with her.
sentences.zh: 他们有一种测试，看看女孩是否到了可以和他们睡觉的年纪。

sentences.en: They would hit her unexpectedly from behind with a rolled cape.
sentences.zh: 他们会用卷起来的斗篷从背后出其不意地打她一下。

sentences.en: If she remained upright, she was considered sufficiently old.
sentences.zh: 如果她还能站稳，就被认为年纪足够了。

sentences.en: So this is obviously a problem for Manco.
sentences.zh: 所以这对曼科来说显然是个问题。

sentences.en: Manco is regarded as the Spaniard's man, as their puppet to some extent.
sentences.zh: 曼科被视为西班牙人的走狗，在某种程度上是他们的傀儡。

sentences.en: He entered the city with Pizarro's troops.
sentences.zh: 他随皮萨罗的军队进入了城市。

sentences.en: He stood there nodding and smiling when Pizarro read out the requirement.
sentences.zh: 当皮萨罗宣读《要求书》时，他站在那里点头微笑。

sentences.en: So some of the Inca elite start by early 1535 to say, you know, is he the right man?
sentences.zh: 所以一些印加精英在1535年初就开始质疑，他真的是合适的人选吗？

sentences.en: Is he standing up to these people, or is he just there at all?
sentences.zh: 他是在对抗这些人，还是仅仅是个摆设？

sentences.en: And what makes this so dangerous is that the Spaniards themselves have started to fall out with each other.
sentences.zh: 而最危险的是，西班牙人自己也开始内讧了。

sentences.en: So all through this series, the feud between Pizarro and Almagro, the two business partners, has been getting worse and worse.
sentences.zh: 所以在这整个系列中，皮萨罗和阿尔马格罗这两位商业伙伴之间的宿怨一直在不断恶化。

sentences.en: Remember that Pizarro went to Spain.
sentences.zh: 记得皮萨罗去了西班牙。

sentences.en: He came back with a great title for himself and basically nothing for Almagro.
sentences.zh: 他回来时给自己争取到了显赫的头衔，却基本上没给阿尔马格罗留什么。

sentences.en: Then Almagro turned up late, as agreed, and Pizarro wouldn't give him a share of the ransom or a fair share of the ransom.
sentences.zh: 后来阿尔马格罗迟到了，皮萨罗就不愿分给他赎金，或者说不愿公平地分给他赎金。

sentences.en: Early 1535, Pizarro has moved to the coast to found the city of Lima.
sentences.zh: 1535年初，皮萨罗搬到了沿海地区，建立了利马城。

sentences.en: Basically, he wants a base nearer the coast, and he's got this new city.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他想要一个离海岸更近的基地，于是他有了这座新城。

sentences.en: And he says to Almagro, you can be the lieutenant governor of Cusco.
sentences.zh: 他对阿尔马格罗说，你可以担任库斯科的副总督。

sentences.en: But Almagro's men, who are mostly newcomers, start feuding with the old guard who have been there for a year and a half now.
sentences.zh: 但阿尔马格罗的手下大多是新来的，开始与已经在那里待了一年半的老卫队发生争执。

sentences.en: And these are led by Pizarro's younger brothers, Juan and Gonzalo.
sentences.zh: 而这些人由皮萨罗的弟弟胡安和贡萨洛领导。

sentences.en: To cut a very long story short, they start brawling in the central square.
sentences.zh: 长话短说，他们在中心广场打了起来。

sentences.en: The Almagristas, as they're called, Almagro's faction, and Juan and Gonzalo's faction.
sentences.zh: 所谓的“阿尔马格罗派”，也就是阿尔马格罗的阵营，与胡安和贡萨洛的阵营。

sentences.en: And there's all sorts of goings on, kind of royal officials have to separate them.
sentences.zh: 各种事情接连发生，皇家官员不得不出面调停。

sentences.en: And basically, Manco has to choose.
sentences.zh: 基本上，曼科必须做出选择。

sentences.en: Is he going to go with Juan and Gonzalo, or is he going to go with Almagro?
sentences.zh: 他是要站在胡安和贡萨洛这边，还是站在阿尔马格罗这边？

sentences.en: Now, you might expect that because he owes his throne to the Pizarro brothers, he will pick the Pizarro's.
sentences.zh: 你可能会认为，既然他的王位是皮萨罗兄弟给的，他会选择皮萨罗兄弟。

sentences.en: But no.
sentences.zh: 但并没有。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, Juan and Gonzalo, who I described in the first episode as variously affable, noble, magnanimous, virtuous.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，我在第一集里描述为和蔼、高尚、宽宏大量、品德高尚的胡安和贡萨洛。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: How's that working out?
sentences.zh: 结果如何呢？

sentences.en: They've let the Pizarro family, the town of Trujillo, the province of Extremadura, and Spain down very badly.
sentences.zh: 他们让皮萨罗家族、特鲁希略镇、埃斯特雷马杜拉省以及西班牙蒙羞。

sentences.en: They've really behaved poorly.
sentences.zh: 他们的表现真的很差劲。

sentences.en: Because basically, with their older brother, Francisco, away on the coast, they've cast off all restraints, and they're disgracing themselves.
sentences.zh: 因为基本上，随着他们的长兄弗朗西斯科在海岸边，他们抛弃了所有约束，自取其辱。

sentences.en: They both want local women.
sentences.zh: 他们都想要当地女人。

sentences.en: Juan kidnaps Manco's younger sister, who's called Inquilcoya, even though, and I quote, she was very young and an unmarried maiden.
sentences.zh: 胡安绑架了曼科的妹妹因基尔科亚，尽管引用原文，“她还很年轻，是个未婚少女”。

sentences.en: He kept her locked in his house, where he made her sleep with him.
sentences.zh: 他把她锁在屋里，强迫她与他同寝。

sentences.en: But Gonzalo is just as bad.
sentences.zh: 但贡萨洛也好不到哪去。

sentences.en: He sets his sights on her older sister, Cura Oculo, who is already Manco's wife.
sentences.zh: 他盯上了她的姐姐库拉·奥克洛，她已经是曼科的妻子了。

sentences.en: So she's Manco's wife and his sister.
sentences.zh: 所以她既是曼科的妻子，也是他的姐妹。

sentences.en: This is very Ptolemaic behavior, but this is standard for the Incas.
sentences.zh: 这行为非常托勒密式，但这在印加人中是常态。

sentences.en: The high priest, who was also Manco's brother, so her half-brother as well, tried to stop him and said, you know, you shouldn't be trying to sleep with this woman.
sentences.zh: 大祭司也是曼科的兄弟，也就是她同父异母的兄弟，试图阻止他，说你不应该试图和这个女人睡觉。

sentences.en: And Gonzalo said to him, don't you know what sort of men we Spaniards are?
sentences.zh: 贡萨洛对他说，你不知道我们西班牙人是什么样的人吗？

sentences.en: By the king's life, if you don't shut up, I'll slit you open and cut you into little pieces.
sentences.zh: 以国王的名义，如果你再不住口，我就把你剖开，切成碎片。

sentences.en: So what is going on here?
sentences.zh: 这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: It seems really odd that these men would deliberately humiliate and insult the man who is so important to their maintenance of ruling Cusco and the empire more generally.
sentences.zh: 这些人竟然故意羞辱那个对他们维持库斯科及整个帝国统治至关重要的人，这看起来真的很奇怪。

sentences.en: See, I don't think it is that odd.
sentences.zh: 你看，我不觉得这有多奇怪。

sentences.en: I think it's human nature.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是人性。

sentences.en: They see him as their puppets.
sentences.zh: 他们视他为傀儡。

sentences.en: They're bullies.
sentences.zh: 他们是恶霸。

sentences.en: They have a little bit of contempt for him.
sentences.zh: 他们对他有一点轻蔑。

sentences.en: They have weapons and he doesn't, really.
sentences.zh: 他们有武器，而他几乎没有。

sentences.en: He's dependent on them.
sentences.zh: 他依赖于他们。

sentences.en: They don't speak his language.
sentences.zh: 他们不会说他的语言。

sentences.en: They look down on him and his custoMs.
sentences.zh: 他们看不起他和他的习俗。

sentences.en: And over time, I think these guys who remember, they're not educated men.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，我认为这些家伙——记住，他们不是受过教育的人。

sentences.en: They're tough, hard men from basically the Wild WeSt.
sentences.zh: 他们是来自“狂野西部”的强硬、粗鲁的人。

sentences.en: But they know the stakes.
sentences.zh: 但他们知道利害关系。

sentences.en: I mean, they're not naive.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们并不天真。

sentences.en: They understand that they need to maintain, you know, a degree of Incan support for their very precarious regime in Cusco.
sentences.zh: 他们明白，为了维持他们在库斯科岌岌可危的政权，他们需要保持一定程度的印加支持。

sentences.en: It just seems very odd.
sentences.zh: 这看起来还是很奇怪。

sentences.en: And it may, I mean, maybe you're right that it is a deliberate attempt to humiliate Manco.
sentences.zh: 也许你是对的，这可能是一种蓄意羞辱曼科的尝试。

sentences.en: Well, we'll see them.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们会看到的。

sentences.en: They really do humiliate him later on, don't they?
sentences.zh: 他们后来确实羞辱了他，不是吗？

sentences.en: Or is it the fact that they are princesses, the key thing that if they can marry the princess, then perhaps they can, you know, hopes of founding a royal dynasty?
sentences.zh: 还是说，关键在于她们是公主，如果能娶到公主，或许他们就能有建立皇朝的希望？

sentences.en: It does seem unwise, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我想这看起来很不理智。

sentences.en: It is unwise.
sentences.zh: 确实不理智。

sentences.en: They're unwise people.
sentences.zh: 他们是不理智的人。

sentences.en: They will behave in the next two episodes.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的两集里，他们的行为会证明这一点。

sentences.en: All of these people will behave incredibly unwisely.
sentences.zh: 所有这些人都会表现得极其不理智。

sentences.en: I mean, you can't deny that because I know you've read the notes.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你无法否认这一点，因为我知道你读过笔记。

sentences.en: They will behave really, really mad, recklessly, poorly, hot-headedly.
sentences.zh: 他们的行为会非常、非常疯狂、鲁莽、恶劣、冲动。

sentences.en: But I still think they're not fools.
sentences.zh: 但我仍然认为他们不是傻瓜。

sentences.en: It seems peculiar.
sentences.zh: 这看起来很特别。

sentences.en: There's a sense of something not quite being explained here.
sentences.zh: 总觉得这里有些事情没有完全解释清楚。

sentences.en: I don't think that it can just be a matter of, oh, I fancy them.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这仅仅是“哦，我看上她们了”这么简单。

sentences.en: Because they both fancy princesses.
sentences.zh: 因为他们都看上了公主。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Who are the sisters of the Inca.
sentences.zh: 印加王的姐妹们。

sentences.en: And you feel that that can't be coincidence.
sentences.zh: 你觉得这不可能是巧合。

sentences.en: I don't know about that.
sentences.zh: 我对此不确定。

sentences.en: I think all of the Spanish go for high-born women generally.
sentences.zh: 我认为所有的西班牙人都倾向于追求出身高贵的女性。

sentences.en: Yeah, but these are the highest born, aren't they?
sentences.zh: 是的，但她们是出身最高贵的，不是吗？

sentences.en: So...
sentences.zh: 所以……

sentences.en: They are, but that's not necessarily different from how the Spanish behaved in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 她们确实是，但这与西班牙人在墨西哥的行为并没有什么不同。

sentences.en: It's a bit like Cleopatra only sleeping with very powerful men.
sentences.zh: 这有点像克利奥帕特拉只和最有权势的男人睡觉。

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: I mean, anyway, Manco actually offers Gonzalo money.
sentences.zh: 总之，曼科确实给了贡萨洛钱。

sentences.en: To get back to the story, Manco offers Gonzalo loads of silver.
sentences.zh: 回到故事，曼科给了贡萨洛大量的白银。

sentences.en: And Gonzalo said to him, all this silver is fine, but it's the woman I really want.
sentences.zh: 贡萨洛对他说，这些银子很好，但我真正想要的是那个女人。

sentences.en: And Manco did a mad thing where he got her sister's companion, her friend.
sentences.zh: 曼科做了一件疯狂的事，他找来了她姐姐的同伴，她的朋友。

sentences.en: He forced her to dress up as his sister to try and fool Gonzalo.
sentences.zh: 他强迫她打扮成他姐姐的样子，试图欺骗贡萨洛。

sentences.en: Gonzalo was not fooled.
sentences.zh: 贡萨洛没有上当。

sentences.en: And eventually he got his hands on Cura Oclo, who actually worse is going to happen to her in the next episode, I'm afraid.
sentences.zh: 最终他还是抓住了库拉·奥克洛，恐怕在下一集中，她会遭遇更糟糕的事情。

sentences.en: So Manco's very bitter about all this, and he decides to side with Almagro in the feuding.
sentences.zh: 所以曼科对此感到非常痛苦，他决定在内讧中站在阿尔马格罗一边。

sentences.en: And this then creates yet another split, because some of Manco's relatives say, well, that's mad, you should be siding with the Pizarro's.
sentences.zh: 这又造成了另一次分裂，因为曼科的一些亲戚说，这太疯狂了，你应该站在皮萨罗一边。

sentences.en: So the factionalism now sort of seeps like a poison into Manco's court.
sentences.zh: 所以派系斗争现在像毒药一样渗入了曼科的宫廷。

sentences.en: One evening, Manco becomes absolutely terrified that these other Incas are going to murder him.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，曼科变得非常恐惧，担心其他印加人会谋杀他。

sentences.en: And he ends up fleeing to Almagro's house and hiding under his bed, which seems a weird thing to do.
sentences.zh: 最后他逃到了阿尔马格罗的房子里，躲在他的床下，这看起来是个奇怪的举动。

sentences.en: And while he's doing that, loads of other Spaniards find out, and they rush to Manco's house and start looting it.
sentences.zh: 当他躲在那里时，许多其他西班牙人发现了，他们冲进曼科的房子开始洗劫。

sentences.en: So when he comes back the next day, he says, can I have my stuff back?
sentences.zh: 所以当他第二天回来时，他说，能把我的东西还给我吗？

sentences.en: And they say, no, you know, you went and hid under the bed.
sentences.zh: 他们说，不行，是你自己躲到床底下的。

sentences.en: We've got your stuff.
sentences.zh: 东西现在归我们了。

sentences.en: You snooze, you lose, basically.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是，手慢无。

sentences.en: Anyway, this is all obviously very chaotic and very bad for the Spanish regime.
sentences.zh: 总之，这一切显然非常混乱，对西班牙政权非常不利。

sentences.en: So Francisco Pizarro rushes back from Lima to try and sort this out.
sentences.zh: 所以弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗从利马赶回来试图解决这个问题。

sentences.en: And he says, OK, I'm going to try and sort this out.
sentences.zh: 他说，好吧，我来试着解决这个问题。

sentences.en: And what I'm going to do is, Almagro, I think you should go to Chile.
sentences.zh: 我要做的是，阿尔马格罗，我觉得你应该去智利。

sentences.en: And basically, there's clearly going to be another empire there or rich lands or something.
sentences.zh: 基本上，那边显然会有另一个帝国，或者富饶的土地之类的。

sentences.en: Go down there.
sentences.zh: 去那边吧。

sentences.en: I will give you funding, actually.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我会给你提供资金。

sentences.en: You know, you're my business partner.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你是我的商业伙伴。

sentences.en: I'll put more money into your enterprise.
sentences.zh: 我会给你的企业投入更多资金。

sentences.en: You can go off to Chile and carve out your own empire there, which will end up being called New Toledo.
sentences.zh: 你可以去智利，在那里开创属于你自己的帝国，最终会被命名为新托莱多。

sentences.en: Do you think he knows that there's nothing there?
sentences.zh: 你觉得他知道那里什么都没有吗？

sentences.en: I mean, he's been down in Lima.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他一直待在利马。

sentences.en: No, I don't, because it's a long old way.
sentences.zh: 不，我不觉得，因为那是一段很长的老路。

sentences.en: They don't really know what's there, I think.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们并不真正知道那里有什么。

sentences.en: And actually, Almagro ends up marching past the great mine at Potosi, which becomes the most lucrative mine in the world.
sentences.zh: 事实上，阿尔马格罗最终经过了波托西大矿山，那后来成了世界上最赚钱的矿山。

sentences.en: He doesn't realise it's there.
sentences.zh: 他没意识到它的存在。

sentences.en: So there was money there if he had found it, but he didn't.
sentences.zh: 所以如果他找到了，那里是有钱的，但他没找到。

sentences.en: But he's going to end up marching across the driest desert in the world, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 但他最终会穿过世界上最干旱的沙漠，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: Kind of think Pizarro has some sense of the geography.
sentences.zh: 我觉得皮萨罗对地理还是有点概念的。

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: So anyway, Almagro sets off for Chile.
sentences.zh: 总之，阿尔马格罗出发前往智利了。

sentences.en: He's got 600 Spaniards.
sentences.zh: 他带了600名西班牙人。

sentences.en: And actually, Manco gives him an army of 12,000 men, commanded by the high priest Villac Umu and Manco's brother, Paolo.
sentences.zh: 实际上，曼科还给了他一支12000人的军队，由大祭司维拉克·乌穆和曼科的兄弟保罗指挥。

sentences.en: So off they go to the south.
sentences.zh: 于是他们出发向南了。

sentences.en: And it's a complete and utter nightmare.
sentences.zh: 那简直是一场彻头彻尾的噩梦。

sentences.en: They have been totally unprepared for climbing up onto the high Andean plateau, the Altiplano, which is basically Bolivia and northern Chile.
sentences.zh: 他们完全没有准备好攀登安第斯高原，也就是阿尔蒂普拉诺高原，那基本上就是玻利维亚和智利北部。

sentences.en: They run out of water.
sentences.zh: 他们的水喝光了。

sentences.en: They absolutely disgraced themselves this expedition.
sentences.zh: 这次远征让他们彻底丢尽了脸面。

sentences.en: There's a priest called Cristobal de Molina who is with them.
sentences.zh: 有一个叫克里斯托瓦尔·德·莫利纳的牧师和他们在一起。
zh_words: 克里斯托瓦尔·德·莫利纳

sentences.en: And he said,
sentences.zh: 他说，

sentences.en: Any natives who would not accompany the Spaniards voluntarily were taken along bound in ropes and chains.
sentences.zh: 任何不愿自愿跟随西班牙人的原住民，都被绳索和铁链捆绑着带走。

sentences.en: The Spaniards imprisoned them in very rough prisons every night and led them by day heavily loaded and dying of hunger.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人每天晚上把他们关在非常简陋的监狱里，白天让他们负重前行，任由他们饿死。

sentences.en: So they've got these huge chain gangs.
sentences.zh: 所以他们有这些巨大的苦役链。

sentences.en: When somebody dies in the chain gang, which they do all the time because they're exhausted, they're hungry, thirsty, whatever, the Spaniards do something very horrible.
sentences.zh: 当有人在苦役链中死去时——因为精疲力竭、饥渴交加，这种情况时有发生——西班牙人会做一件非常可怕的事。

sentences.en: They cut the heads off these people who have died, but they leave the bodies still attached to the chain.
sentences.zh: 他们砍下死者的头，但让尸体依然挂在链子上。

sentences.en: So as you're trudging along, you're having to kind of drag this corpse, drag this corpse, which could be in front of you, behind you in the chain.
sentences.zh: 所以当你艰难跋涉时，你不得不拖着这具尸体，拖着这具尸体，它可能就在你链子的前面或后面。

sentences.en: Both.
sentences.zh: 都有。

sentences.en: I mean, it's pretty horrible.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这太可怕了。

sentences.en: They get to southern Bolivia.
sentences.zh: 他们到达了玻利维亚南部。

sentences.en: And at this point, the high priest, Vilak Umu, who's gone with them, deserts.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，随行的大祭司维拉克·乌穆逃跑了。

sentences.en: And he goes back to Cusco.
sentences.zh: 他回到了库斯科。

sentences.en: He rushes back to Cusco.
sentences.zh: 他匆忙赶回库斯科。

sentences.en: He gets to Cusco and he meets up with Manco and he says,
sentences.zh: 他到了库斯科，见到了曼科，他说，

sentences.en: These people are absolute scum.
sentences.zh: 这些人简直是人渣。

sentences.en: They're behaving terribly badly.
sentences.zh: 他们的行为极其恶劣。

sentences.en: You know, we can't live like this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们不能这样生活。

sentences.en: We cannot spend our entire lives in misery and subjection.
sentences.zh: 我们不能终生生活在苦难和屈从之中。

sentences.en: Let us die for our liberty and for the wives and children whom they continually take from us and abuse.
sentences.zh: 让我们为自由而死，为那些被他们不断夺走并虐待的妻儿而死。

sentences.en: I will say one thing about all these tremendous quotations.
sentences.zh: 关于所有这些惊人的引语，我想说一点。

sentences.en: Some of these are by people who I think had had classical educations.
sentences.zh: 其中一些出自我觉得受过古典教育的人之口。

sentences.en: So if it strikes you as the Incas are speaking very much like people spoke in our Carthage series, this is probably the explanation.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你觉得印加人说话的方式很像我们在迦太基系列中听到的人，这可能就是原因。

sentences.en: Anyway, Manco summons this great meeting, November 1535.
sentences.zh: 总之，曼科在1535年11月召开了这次盛大的会议。

sentences.en: And actually, you know, that speech that you began with, Tom, is very, very, you know,
sentences.zh: 实际上，你知道，汤姆，你开头引用的那段演讲，非常非常，你知道，

sentences.en: Carthaginian resistance or something, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 很像迦太基人的抵抗之类的，不是吗？

sentences.en: However, it was reported to us by a chronicler called Thieta de Leon, and he said he had an eyewitness account from a servant called Alimache.
sentences.zh: 然而，这是由一位名叫提埃塔·德·莱昂的编年史家向我们报道的，他说他从一个叫阿利马切的仆人那里得到了目击者的陈述。

sentences.en: Oh, well then.
sentences.zh: 哦，那好吧。

sentences.en: So it must be true.
sentences.zh: 那肯定是真的了。

sentences.en: And he had a recording device.
sentences.zh: 而且他还有录音设备。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's basically a transcript.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是一份文字记录。

sentences.en: Manco said, you know,
sentences.zh: 曼科说，你知道，

sentences.en: I've sent for you, my kinsmen, to tell you what I think about these foreigners before it's too late, before more foreigners join them.
sentences.zh: 我召集你们，我的族人，是为了在为时已晚之前，在更多外国人加入他们之前，告诉你们我对这些外国人的看法。

sentences.en: They're waking up to that then.
sentences.zh: 他们那时开始意识到这一点了。

sentences.en: They are.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That more foreigners are coming, because that's what Francisco Pizarro is doing on the coast at Lima.
sentences.zh: 会有更多外国人到来，因为这就是弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗在利马海岸正在做的事。

sentences.en: He's basically preparing a base for people to arrive as they sail down the Pacific.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是在为人们沿太平洋航行抵达这里建立一个基地。

sentences.en: So Manco runs through all the bullet points that you did at the beginning of the episode.
sentences.zh: 所以曼科回顾了你在本集开头提到的所有要点。

sentences.en: Spaniards lust for gold, treatments of women, poor behaviour, and then the stirring final line, we'll strive with all our might to kill them, or we will die in the attempt.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人对黄金的贪婪、对女性的对待、恶劣的行为，然后是那句激昂的结束语：我们将竭尽全力杀死他们，否则我们就在尝试中死去。

sentences.en: And I suppose what you would say if you were being hostile to Manco is, if only he'd realised this a year earlier, he could have teamed up with Attawalpa's old generals.
sentences.zh: 我想如果你对曼科持敌对态度，你会说，要是他早一年意识到这一点，他本可以和阿塔瓦尔帕的老将军们联手。

sentences.en: So he could have had Rumi Niawi with his drum, his human drum, on his side.
sentences.zh: 这样他就能让鲁米·尼亚维带着他的鼓，那面人皮鼓，站在他这一边了。

sentences.en: But alas, he tried to use the Spaniards against them, and so he's going to be doing this on his own.
sentences.zh: 但可惜，他试图利用西班牙人来对付他们，所以他只能孤军奋战了。

sentences.en: So that night, after this meeting,
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，会议结束后，

sentences.en: Manco and his entourage slip out of Cusco under cover of darkness to launch the resistance.
sentences.zh: 曼科和他的随从在夜色的掩护下溜出库斯科，发动抵抗。

sentences.en: But they are betrayed,
sentences.zh: 但他们被出卖了，

sentences.en: because one of their servants was a spy for the Pizarro brothers.
sentences.zh: 因为他们的一个仆人是皮萨罗兄弟的间谍。

sentences.en: As soon as Manco is gone, this servant rushes off to Juan and Gonzalo Pizarro, and he says, yeah, Manco's gone.
sentences.zh: 曼科一走，这个仆人就冲向胡安和贡萨洛·皮萨罗，说，是的，曼科走了。

sentences.en: So they ride off in pursuit, and they find on the road south out of Cusco loads of Incas.
sentences.zh: 于是他们骑马追赶，在库斯科南下的路上发现了许多印加人。

sentences.en: And they say, were you with Manco?
sentences.zh: 他们问，你们和曼科在一起吗？

sentences.en: Where did Manco go?
sentences.zh: 曼科去哪儿了？

sentences.en: And the Incas don't answer.
sentences.zh: 印加人没有回答。

sentences.en: So they seized one of them, and according to the Spanish chroniclers, tortured him astutely until he gave a great shout, saying the Inca was not going that way.
sentences.zh: 于是他们抓住了其中一人，据西班牙编年史家记载，对他进行了“精明”的拷问，直到他大喊一声，说印加人不是往那个方向走的。

sentences.en: How do you torture someone astutely?
sentences.zh: 你怎么能“精明”地拷问一个人？

sentences.en: Well, Tom, I mean, if you know, you know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，汤姆，我是说，如果你懂，你就懂。

sentences.en: You know.
sentences.zh: 你懂的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So they've tortured him astutely with this rope, and the guy finally shouts out, he's not going that way.
sentences.zh: 所以他们用绳子对他进行了“精明”的拷问，那家伙终于喊出来，他不是往那个方向走的。

sentences.en: Well, actually, Manco has gone that way.
sentences.zh: 嗯，实际上，曼科就是往那个方向走的。

sentences.en: They find him hiding in some reeds at the end of the valley.
sentences.zh: 他们在山谷尽头的芦苇丛中找到了躲藏的他。

sentences.en: Now, they drag Manco back.
sentences.zh: 现在，他们把曼科拖了回来。

sentences.en: Remember, Manco is the Sapa Inca, the son of the sun.
sentences.zh: 记住，曼科是萨帕·印加，太阳之子。

sentences.en: And this shows the extent to which the Spanish respect has completely degenerated into total contempt.
sentences.zh: 这显示了西班牙人的尊重已经完全退化为彻底的蔑视。

sentences.en: Because they drag him back, they throw him into prison with a chain around his neck and shackles on his feet, and then they treat him very badly.
sentences.zh: 因为他们把他拖回来，把他扔进监狱，脖子上套着铁链，脚上戴着镣铐，然后对他百般虐待。

sentences.en: So these are from Spanish sources, right?
sentences.zh: 这些是来自西班牙的消息来源，对吧？

sentences.en: This is Diego del Magro's son.
sentences.zh: 这是迭戈·德·阿尔马格罗的儿子说的。

sentences.en: They urinated and spat in his face.
sentences.zh: 他们在他脸上撒尿和吐口水。

sentences.en: They struck and beat him.
sentences.zh: 他们殴打他。

sentences.en: They called him a dog.
sentences.zh: 他们叫他狗。

sentences.en: They kept him with a chain around his neck in a public place where people passed.
sentences.zh: 他们把他脖子上套着铁链关在一个公共场所，让人们经过。

sentences.en: This is that priest, Cristobal de Molina.
sentences.zh: 这是那个牧师，克里斯托瓦尔·德·莫利纳说的。
zh_words: 克里斯托瓦尔·德·莫利纳

sentences.en: They stole everything he had, leaving him nothing.
sentences.zh: 他们偷走了他所有的一切，让他一无所有。

sentences.en: They kept him in prison for many days, guarded day and night.
sentences.zh: 他们把他关在监狱里很多天，日夜看守。

sentences.en: They treated him very, very disgracefully, urinating on him and sleeping with his wives, and he was deeply distressed.
sentences.zh: 他们对他非常非常无礼，在他身上撒尿，还和他的妻子们睡觉，他深感痛苦。

sentences.en: The whole urinating on him thing, I mean, that seems clearly did happen.
sentences.zh: 关于在他身上撒尿这件事，我是说，这显然确实发生了。

sentences.en: Because the way they keep harping on about it, precisely.
sentences.zh: 因为他们一直喋喋不休地提起这件事，正是如此。

sentences.en: And it's not a detail you often see in 16th century accounts.
sentences.zh: 而且这在16世纪的记载中并不常见。

sentences.en: They also do a terrible thing where they burn his eyelashes with a candle, shouting at him, dog, give us gold.
sentences.zh: 他们还做了一件可怕的事，用蜡烛烧他的睫毛，对他大喊：狗，把黄金交出来。

sentences.en: If not, you will be burned.
sentences.zh: 不然，你就被烧死。

sentences.en: So basically, they're just torturing him.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，他们就是在折磨他。

sentences.en: I mean, they're tormenting and torturing him.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们在折磨和拷打他。

sentences.en: Astutely.
sentences.zh: “精明”地。

sentences.en: The word obviously spreads because there are now uprisings across the countryside.
sentences.zh: 消息显然传开了，因为现在全国各地都爆发了起义。

sentences.en: There were reports coming in that when Spaniards go out to their estates to collect their tribute, the locals are rising up and attacking them,
sentences.zh: 有报告称，当西班牙人外出到他们的庄园征收贡品时，当地人正在起义并攻击他们，

sentences.en: and about 30 Spaniards in total are killed.
sentences.zh: 总共约有30名西班牙人被杀。

sentences.en: Gonzalo and Juan Pizarro ride out of the city to exact really horrendous reprisals.
sentences.zh: 贡萨洛和胡安·皮萨罗骑马冲出城市，进行极其恐怖的报复。

sentences.en: There's lots of burning people alive.
sentences.zh: 有很多人被活活烧死。

sentences.en: There's lots of cutting people's arms and legs off, all of this kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 有很多人被砍断手脚，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: And then in January 1536, there's a little bit of a change because their older brother,
sentences.zh: 然后在1536年1月，情况发生了一点变化，因为他们的哥哥，

sentences.en: Hernando, returns from Spain.
sentences.zh: 埃尔南多，从西班牙回来了。

sentences.en: Now, you may remember that Pizarro had sent Hernando to Spain to take the gold to the court to show Charles V.
sentences.zh: 现在，你可能记得皮萨罗曾派埃尔南多去西班牙，把黄金带到宫廷展示给查理五世看。

sentences.en: And Hernando had done this and it was very successful and it had been very good for the Pizarro faction.
sentences.zh: 埃尔南多做到了，非常成功，这对皮萨罗派系非常有利。

sentences.en: Hernando has now returned.
sentences.zh: 埃尔南多现在回来了。

sentences.en: He had previously, if you remember, been quite pally with Attawalpa.
sentences.zh: 如果你还记得，他之前和阿塔瓦尔帕的关系还不错。

sentences.en: And he does seem to have been a little bit more sympathetic to the locals than his boorishly behaved brothers.
sentences.zh: 而且他似乎确实比他那些行为粗鲁的兄弟们对当地人更有同情心。

sentences.en: So he arrives in Cusco and he says, what's all this?
sentences.zh: 所以他到达库斯科，说，这都是怎么回事？

sentences.en: You know, we need to change the record a bit.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们需要稍微改变一下记录。

sentences.en: So he goes to see Manko, who's recently been released.
sentences.zh: 于是他去见曼科，曼科最近刚被释放。

sentences.en: He treats him with great courtesy.
sentences.zh: 他非常有礼貌地对待他。

sentences.en: He says, you know,
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道，

sentences.en: I've been speaking to Charles V.
sentences.zh: 我和查理五世谈过了。

sentences.en: Charles V really respects you.
sentences.zh: 查理五世非常尊重你。

sentences.en: Things have got a little bit out of hand and, you know, I'm sorry about that.
sentences.zh: 事情有点失控了，你知道，对此我很抱歉。

sentences.en: We can start again.
sentences.zh: 我们可以重新开始。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, if you have any self-respect as a person, I feel like if you've been urinated on, if somebody has slept with your wives,
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，如果你作为一个人的自尊心还在，我觉得如果你被人撒过尿，如果有人和你的妻子们睡过觉，

sentences.en: there's no coming back from that really, is there?
sentences.zh: 那真的就无法挽回了，不是吗？

sentences.en: You can't start again.
sentences.zh: 你无法重新开始。

sentences.en: You can't let bygones be bygones.
sentences.zh: 你无法让往事随风。

sentences.en: So Manko, in the early months of 1536, starts plotting with his brother, the high priest, Vilak Umu.
sentences.zh: 所以曼科在1536年初开始与他的兄弟，大祭司维拉克·乌穆密谋。

sentences.en: And they make their plans.
sentences.zh: 他们制定了计划。

sentences.en: By the end of the rainy season, which is late March, the word has gone out.
sentences.zh: 雨季结束时，也就是3月下旬，消息传开了。

sentences.en: We'll make weapons in secret, get people to stockpile food and supplies.
sentences.zh: 我们要秘密制造武器，让人们储备食物和补给。

sentences.en: And then in April, they send messages out across the empire with their lovely knotted strings, the kippus.
sentences.zh: 然后在4月，他们用可爱的结绳记事——奇普，向整个帝国发送了信息。

sentences.en: They say, this is on.
sentences.zh: 他们说，开始了。

sentences.en: We're going to do this.
sentences.zh: 我们要干了。

sentences.en: We can have a massive uprising.
sentences.zh: 我们要发动一场大规模的起义。

sentences.en: The muster point will be a place called Lares in the Yukai Valley, the Sacred Valley,
sentences.zh: 集结点将是尤凯谷，也就是圣谷中的一个叫拉雷斯的地方，

sentences.en: 15 miles north of Cusco.
sentences.zh: 在库斯科以北15英里处。

sentences.en: And the question is, how is Manko?
sentences.zh: 问题是，曼科现在怎么样了？

sentences.en: Remember when he tried to get out of the city last time, there was action with astute use of ropes.
sentences.zh: 记得上次他试图逃出城市时，发生了“精明”使用绳索的行动。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: How is he going to get out this time?
sentences.zh: 这次他要怎么逃出去？

sentences.en: He has a very clever wheeze.
sentences.zh: 他有一个非常聪明的诡计。

sentences.en: He uses the Spaniard's greed against them.
sentences.zh: 他利用了西班牙人的贪婪来对付他们。

sentences.en: He goes to Hernando and he says, my brother, the high priest,
sentences.zh: 他去找埃尔南多，说：我的兄弟，大祭司，

sentences.en: Vilak Umu and I would like to go to a religious festival in the Sacred Valley.
sentences.zh: 维拉克·乌穆和我想要去圣谷参加一个宗教节日。

sentences.en: And actually, if you let us go, they've got a giant golden statue of my father,
sentences.zh: 实际上，如果你让我们去，他们那里有一座我父亲的巨大金像，

sentences.en: Hwena Capac, and I'd love you to have it.
sentences.zh: 瓦伊纳·卡帕克，我很乐意送给你。

sentences.en: And Hernando says, oh, well, in that case, why haven't you left already?
sentences.zh: 埃尔南多说：哦，既然这样，你们为什么还不出发呢？

sentences.en: My goodness, of course you can go.
sentences.zh: 天哪，你们当然可以去。

sentences.en: So on the Wednesday before Easter, after mass,
sentences.zh: 于是，在复活节前的那个星期三，做完弥撒后，

sentences.en: Manko and Vilakumma go out of the city.
sentences.zh: 曼科和维拉克·乌穆离开了城市。

sentences.en: Now on the way, they meet another conquistador, who's very suspicious.
sentences.zh: 在路上，他们遇到了另一位非常多疑的征服者。

sentences.en: Where are you going off to?
sentences.zh: 你们要去哪儿？

sentences.en: And Manko says, well, we've found there's some hidden gold in those hills and we're going to go and get it.
sentences.zh: 曼科说：哦，我们发现那些山里藏着一些黄金，我们正要去把它取回来。

sentences.en: Oh, well then, good luck.
sentences.zh: 哦，那祝你们好运。

sentences.en: So they get to Lares and all the big Inca chiefs are there.
sentences.zh: 他们到达了拉雷斯，所有的印加酋长都在那里。

sentences.en: And there are loads more of these rousing speeches.
sentences.zh: 还有更多慷慨激昂的演讲。

sentences.en: They all swear an oath.
sentences.zh: 他们都发了誓。

sentences.en: We'll drive the Spaniards out of our country or die in the attempt.
sentences.zh: 我们要么把西班牙人赶出我们的国家，要么在尝试中牺牲。

sentences.en: And actually,
sentences.zh: 事实上，

sentences.en: Manko is delighted to discover that his local sort of chiefs and commanders and bigwigs have done him a great job.
sentences.zh: 曼科很高兴地发现，他当地的酋长、指挥官和权贵们出色地完成了任务。

sentences.en: They have gathered about 100,000 people and they have somehow armed them and fed them.
sentences.zh: 他们集结了大约十万人，并以某种方式武装和供养了他们。

sentences.en: These people have come from the land.
sentences.zh: 这些人都是从土地上来的。

sentences.en: So they're peasants and farmers and stuff, but they've been given clubs and whatnot.
sentences.zh: 他们是农民和农夫之类的人，但他们被分发了棍棒之类的武器。

sentences.en: And slings, right?
sentences.zh: 还有投石索，对吧？

sentences.en: And slings, exactly.
sentences.zh: 还有投石索，没错。

sentences.en: And they are outside the capital.
sentences.zh: 他们就在首都外面。

sentences.en: And as John Hemming says in his brilliant book, this is the last great tribute to the Inca's genius for organization.
sentences.zh: 正如约翰·赫明在他那本精彩的书中写道，这是印加人组织天才的最后一次伟大致敬。

sentences.en: It was a very top-down, very collectivist kind of empire.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常自上而下、非常集体主义的帝国。

sentences.en: And this is their last great effort at mobilizing the people.
sentences.zh: 这是他们动员人民的最后一次伟大努力。

sentences.en: So by Easter Saturday, they are moving onto the slopes around Cusco.
sentences.zh: 到了复活节星期六，他们正向库斯科周围的山坡移动。

sentences.en: These giant, giant numbers of people.
sentences.zh: 这些庞大、庞大的人群。

sentences.en: And the Spaniards look out.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人向外望去。

sentences.en: One of them says, there were so many troops, they covered all the fields.
sentences.zh: 其中一人说：军队多到覆盖了所有的田野。

sentences.en: By day, they looked like a black carpet covering everything for half a league around the city.
sentences.zh: 白天，他们看起来像一块黑色的地毯，覆盖了城市周围半里格内的一切。

sentences.en: And by night, there were so many campfires that the land looked like a clear sky filled with stars.
sentences.zh: 晚上，营火多到让大地看起来像一片繁星点点的晴空。

sentences.en: On Easter Saturday,
sentences.zh: 在复活节星期六，

sentences.en: Hernando gets word.
sentences.zh: 埃尔南多得到了消息。

sentences.en: He can't believe this.
sentences.zh: 他简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: You know, what idiots his brothers were to let him down and provoke this uprising.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他的兄弟们竟然让他失望并引发了这场起义，真是蠢货。

sentences.en: And he calls the Spaniards of Cusco to a meeting.
sentences.zh: 他召集库斯科的西班牙人开会。

sentences.en: And he says, well, we're just going to have to resiSt.
sentences.zh: 他说：好吧，我们只能抵抗了。

sentences.en: You know, we're not going to give in to this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们不会向这个屈服的。

sentences.en: But there's only about 200 Spaniards maximum in the city.
sentences.zh: 但城里最多只有大约200名西班牙人。

sentences.en: And they've got 500 native auxiliaries.
sentences.zh: 他们还有500名土著辅助部队。

sentences.en: So these are ethnic groups who don't like the Incas.
sentences.zh: 这些是不喜欢印加人的族群。

sentences.en: The Cagnari and the Chachapoya.
sentences.zh: 卡尼亚里人和查查波亚人。

sentences.en: But they're against maybe 100,000 people.
sentences.zh: 但他们的对手可能有十万人。

sentences.en: I mean, these are not good odds.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这胜算不大。

sentences.en: Hernando orders, he says, well, the Incas were always frightened of our cavalry.
sentences.zh: 埃尔南多下令说：印加人一直很害怕我们的骑兵。

sentences.en: We'll send out our horses.
sentences.zh: 我们派出我们的马匹。

sentences.en: But for the first time, the Incas are there in such numbers that the horses can't maneuver and the crush.
sentences.zh: 但这是印加人第一次以如此庞大的数量出现，以至于马匹无法机动，而且拥挤不堪。

sentences.en: So they're basically pushed back into the city.
sentences.zh: 所以他们基本上被推回了城里。

sentences.en: And the Incas advance and advance and advance till they're camped right outside the walls.
sentences.zh: 印加人不断推进，直到他们在城墙外扎营。

sentences.en: And then we're told they taunted the Spaniards.
sentences.zh: 然后我们被告知他们嘲弄了西班牙人。

sentences.en: And I quote, raising their bare legs at them to show how much they despised them.
sentences.zh: 我引用一下：向他们露出裸露的腿，以显示他们是多么蔑视他们。

sentences.en: So what's going on there?
sentences.zh: 那到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Well, if you've ever met a Peruvian and he's bared his legs at you, you know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果你见过秘鲁人，而他向你露出腿，你就知道了。

sentences.en: Oh, that's what they were doing.
sentences.zh: 哦，原来他们是在做那个。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: You can't pretend that's never happened to you.
sentences.zh: 你不能假装这种事没发生在你身上。

sentences.en: And so, at dawn on the 6th of May,
sentences.zh: 于是，在5月6日的黎明，

sentences.en: Manco orders the assault.
sentences.zh: 曼科下令进攻。

sentences.en: And it is a tremendous scene.
sentences.zh: 那是一个震撼的场景。

sentences.en: Very Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 非常像好莱坞电影。

sentences.en: The sun rises.
sentences.zh: 太阳升起。

sentences.en: And as it does so, the Incas charge down the hillsides.
sentences.zh: 随着太阳升起，印加人冲下了山坡。

sentences.en: They smash through the Spanish defences.
sentences.zh: 他们冲破了西班牙人的防御。

sentences.en: They fight their way into the narrow alleys that lead into the city.
sentences.zh: 他们一路杀进通往城市的狭窄巷道。

sentences.en: They break through the Spanish barricades and palisades.
sentences.zh: 他们突破了西班牙人的路障和栅栏。

sentences.en: They drive back the garrison and they fight their way into the central square.
sentences.zh: 他们击退了守军，并杀入了中央广场。

sentences.en: And all the time, the Incas have this new weapon, a secret weapon.
sentences.zh: 而且一直以来，印加人都有这种新武器，一种秘密武器。

sentences.en: They'd always, you mentioned their slings, they'd always relied very heavily on their slingshots.
sentences.zh: 你提到了他们的投石索，他们一直非常依赖投石索。

sentences.en: But now they've been heating the stones in their campfires.
sentences.zh: 但现在他们一直在营火中加热石头。

sentences.en: They've been wrapping them in kind of cotton wool and then they send them flying onto the thatched roofs of Cusco.
sentences.zh: 他们把石头用棉花之类的东西包起来，然后把它们飞射到库斯科的茅草屋顶上。

sentences.en: And a Spanish chronicle says,
sentences.zh: 一位西班牙编年史作者说：

sentences.en: There was a strong wind that day and as the roofs of the houses were thatched, it seemed at one moment as if the city were one great sheet of flame.
sentences.zh: 那天风很大，由于房子的屋顶是茅草做的，那一刻看起来就像整个城市变成了一片巨大的火海。

sentences.en: So these huge black clouds of smoke start rising above the city.
sentences.zh: 于是，巨大的黑色烟云开始在城市上空升起。

sentences.en: The Spanish are in total chaos.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人陷入了彻底的混乱。

sentences.en: They can't breathe through the smoke.
sentences.zh: 他们被烟雾呛得无法呼吸。

sentences.en: They can't hear their men's orders because of the din from the attackers, the roar of the fires.
sentences.zh: 由于攻击者的喧嚣和火势的咆哮，他们听不到士兵的命令。

sentences.en: And they're being driven further and further and further back.
sentences.zh: 他们被一步步逼退。

sentences.en: And as Manco's son,
sentences.zh: 正如曼科的儿子，

sentences.en: Titucuzi, wrote, They feared that these were to be the last moments of their lives.
sentences.zh: 蒂图·库西所写：他们担心这是他们生命的最后时刻。

sentences.en: They could see no hope of relief and they did not know what to do.
sentences.zh: 他们看不到任何救援的希望，也不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: My goodness.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: So is this the end of Spanish rule in Peru?
sentences.zh: 那么，这是西班牙在秘鲁统治的终结吗？

sentences.en: Is this the restoration of the Incan Empire?
sentences.zh: 这是印加帝国的复辟吗？

sentences.en: Only one way to find out and that is to join us again after a break.
sentences.zh: 只有一个办法可以知道，那就是休息后回来继续收听。

sentences.zh: 如果阿塔瓦尔帕在先锋领航的手中，你认为先锋领航会辜负他吗？

sentences.zh: 自信它是

sentences.en: Hello everyone and welcome back to The Rest is History.
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到《历史的余味》。

sentences.en: It is May 1536 and the troops of Manco, the Incan Emperor, have launched their assault on Cusco where a very small number of Spaniards, fewer than 200, are trapped.
sentences.zh: 现在是1536年5月，印加皇帝曼科的军队对库斯科发动了进攻，那里有极少数西班牙人，不到200人，被困在城中。

sentences.en: The city is burning.
sentences.zh: 城市正在燃烧。

sentences.en: Dominic, is this the end for Hernando Pizarro and his men?
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，这是埃尔南多·皮萨罗和他部下的末日吗？

sentences.en: Well, it's definitely the end for a particular version of Cusco.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这绝对是某种特定版本库斯科的末日。

sentences.en: So Cusco, a beautiful city, but now as
sentences.zh: 所以库斯科，一座美丽的城市，但正如

sentences.en: John Hemming says, stripped for
sentences.zh: 约翰·赫明所说，为了

sentences.en: Ataralpa's ransom, ransacked by Spanish looters and it's now being burned by its own people.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕的赎金被洗劫一空，被西班牙掠夺者洗劫，现在又被它自己的人民焚烧。

sentences.en: And the Spanish have been pushed right back into the central square.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人已经被逼回了中央广场。

sentences.en: As you say, they are trapped and this really is their darkest hour.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，他们被困住了，这确实是他们最黑暗的时刻。

sentences.en: One side of the square though is not burning because it's relatively open.
sentences.zh: 不过广场的一侧没有燃烧，因为那里相对开阔。

sentences.en: There aren't many buildings there.
sentences.zh: 那里没有多少建筑物。

sentences.en: So this is their kind of escape from the smoke and the flames.
sentences.zh: 所以这是他们逃离烟雾和火焰的地方。

sentences.en: And they take refuge in two great buildings at the eastern end of the square.
sentences.zh: 他们躲进了广场东端的两座大楼里。

sentences.en: Amazingly, the Incas don't manage, these are two buildings that the Incas don't manage to set fire to.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，印加人没能成功，这两座建筑印加人没能点燃。

sentences.en: Now later on, some Spanish writers said this was because of divine intervention.
sentences.zh: 后来，一些西班牙作家说这是因为神灵的干预。

sentences.en: It's the Virgin.
sentences.zh: 是圣母。

sentences.en: The Virgin Mary in a blue cloak
sentences.zh: 身穿蓝色斗篷的圣母玛利亚

sentences.en: intervened to put out the fires.
sentences.zh: 出面扑灭了大火。

sentences.en: She had a load of white blankets.
sentences.zh: 她拿了一大堆白毯子。

sentences.en: So she appeared and threw these white blankets over the flames and this saved the Spaniards.
sentences.zh: 于是她现身，把这些白毯子扔到火焰上，这救了西班牙人。

sentences.en: I'm sorry to say, I don't want to disappoint our Catholic listeners, but I believe this is a later invention at least a hundred years later.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉，我不想让我们的天主教听众失望，但我认为这至少是百年后的后人编造出来的。

sentences.en: Didn't Manco Inca's son say that the Spaniards had placed African slaves on the roofs with buckets of water?
sentences.zh: 曼科·印卡（Manco Inca）的儿子不是说西班牙人把非洲奴隶安置在屋顶上，并备好了水桶吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, so that's perfectly plausible.
sentences.zh: 没错，所以这完全说得通。

sentences.en: Slightly less dramatic, but probably, as you say, more plausible.
sentences.zh: 虽然没那么戏剧性，但正如你所说，可能更可信。

sentences.en: It's a good point that you make there because actually throughout this story there are almost certainly some African slaves on hand.
sentences.zh: 你提的这点很好，因为事实上在整个故事中，几乎可以肯定总有一些非洲奴隶在场。

sentences.en: We know that the Spanish had started to import people, they're coming down from Central America and that you don't really get many glimpses of them in the sources,
sentences.zh: 我们知道西班牙人已经开始进口人口，他们从中美洲过来，虽然在史料中很难见到他们的踪影，

sentences.en: but I think you have to imagine that they're always there.
sentences.zh: 但我认为你必须想象他们一直都在那里。

sentences.en: So there's luck, there's brutal hand-to-hand fighting and basically by nightfall the pattern is set.
sentences.zh: 所以，有运气成分，有残酷的肉搏战，基本上到了夜幕降临时，战局已定。

sentences.en: The Spaniards are hemmed into the small corner of Cusco's city centre.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人被困在库斯科市中心的一小块角落里。

sentences.en: The Incas are encamped around them.
sentences.zh: 印卡人驻扎在他们周围。

sentences.en: It feels very like the siege of Tenochtitlan for people who remember our series about the fall of the Aztecs.
sentences.zh: 对于看过我们关于阿兹特克帝国覆灭系列节目的人来说，这感觉非常像特诺奇蒂特兰围城战。

sentences.en: And for the next six days or so of the Spanish fight, days, as one writer puts it, of strenuous toil and danger,
sentences.zh: 在接下来的六天左右，西班牙人进行了战斗，正如一位作家所言，那是充满艰辛和危险的日子，

sentences.en: slowly sort of pushing out from their little redoubt.
sentences.zh: 他们慢慢地从那个小小的堡垒中向外推进。

sentences.en: There are Incas still who are siding with them, aren't there?
sentences.zh: 还有印卡人站在他们那边，对吧？

sentences.en: Even in Cusco.
sentences.zh: 即使在库斯科也是如此。

sentences.en: So it's not like they are completely isolated.
sentences.zh: 所以他们并非完全孤立无援。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There is an element of an Incan civil war going on at the same time.
sentences.zh: 同时还存在着印卡内战的因素。

sentences.en: The Timbiliers.
sentences.zh: 那些提姆比里人（Timbiliers）。

sentences.en: Again, very hard to glimpse in the sources, but we are told that, for example, some of Manco's own brothers side with the Spaniards.
sentences.zh: 同样，在史料中很难窥见，但我们被告知，例如，曼科的一些亲兄弟就站在西班牙人一边。

sentences.en: So throughout this whole story, I mean, you're dead right to point this out.
sentences.zh: 所以贯穿整个故事，我的意思是，你指出这一点非常正确。

sentences.en: Throughout this whole story, it's not a simple matter of Spaniards versus Incas.
sentences.zh: 贯穿整个故事，这不仅仅是西班牙人与印卡人之间的问题。

sentences.en: It is Spaniards and Incas and other, you know, indigenous peoples fighting Incas and other indigenous groups.
sentences.zh: 这是西班牙人和印卡人，以及其他原住民在与印卡人和其他原住民群体作战。

sentences.en: It's just a massive punch-up.
sentences.zh: 这简直是一场大乱斗。

sentences.en: Basically, yes.
sentences.zh: 基本上是这样。

sentences.en: Everyone's fighting each other.
sentences.zh: 所有人都在互相残杀。

sentences.en: They are all fighting each other.
sentences.zh: 他们都在互相战斗。

sentences.en: Some of the Spaniards say to Hernando, you know, the odds are massively against us.
sentences.zh: 一些西班牙人对埃尔南多（Hernando）说，你知道，我们处于绝对劣势。

sentences.en: We should break out of the city and make for the coaSt.
sentences.zh: 我们应该突围出城，前往海岸。

sentences.en: Hernando has the excellent line.
sentences.zh: 埃尔南多说了一句精彩的话。

sentences.en: He says, no, we should fight back.
sentences.zh: 他说，不，我们应该反击。

sentences.en: Better to die fighting than to perish here like hogs.
sentences.zh: 与其像猪一样死在这里，不如战死沙场。

sentences.en: Like hogs.
sentences.zh: 像猪一样。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that's an
sentences.zh: 是啊，我想那是

sentences.en: American translator, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 美国译者加的吧？

sentences.en: So,
sentences.zh: 所以，

sentences.en: Hernando says, listen, we're kind of sitting ducks here because the Incas have taken up a position in the citadel of Sacsayhuaman, which is on this kind of rock spur that overlooks
sentences.zh: 埃尔南多说，听着，我们在这里就像瓮中之鳖，因为印卡人在萨克塞瓦曼（Sacsayhuaman）的城堡里占据了阵地，那是在俯瞰

sentences.en: the city center, right?
sentences.zh: 市中心的一处岩石山脊上，对吧？

sentences.en: And this fortress, this citadel, had been built by Pachacuti, the legendary sort of great
sentences.zh: 这座堡垒，这座城堡，是由帕查库蒂（Pachacuti）建造的，他是那位传奇的伟大

sentences.en: Inca imperialiSt.
sentences.zh: 印卡帝国主义者。

sentences.en: It's a fortress, it's also a temple, it's a huge storehouse, it's this key strategic location.
sentences.zh: 它既是堡垒，也是神庙，还是巨大的仓库，是关键的战略要地。

sentences.en: And Spanish accounts of the citadel of Sacsayhuaman said that it had massive stone walls, it had these huge towers, it had a labyrinth of tunnels.
sentences.zh: 西班牙关于萨克塞瓦曼城堡的记载称，它有厚重的石墙，有巨大的塔楼，还有迷宫般的隧道。

sentences.en: The Spanish writer,
sentences.zh: 西班牙作家

sentences.en: García Lazo de la Vega, said, it's one of the wonders of the world, there was nothing like it in Spain and Europe, it was so vast, the devil himself must have helped to build it,
sentences.zh: 加西拉索·德·拉·维加（García Lazo de la Vega）说，这是世界奇迹之一，在西班牙和欧洲都没有与之媲美的建筑，它太宏伟了，一定是魔鬼亲自帮忙建造的，

sentences.en: actually it was built by forced labour.
sentences.zh: 实际上它是靠强迫劳动建造的。

sentences.en: And Hernando says, right, we have to capture this back, they can rain down missiles on us from this citadel.
sentences.zh: 埃尔南多说，好，我们必须把它夺回来，他们会从城堡上向我们投掷导弹。

sentences.en: So the plan is that his brother Juan will lead the attack with 50 horsemen, they'll burst through the enemy lines, they'll charge up the hill and capture the citadel.
sentences.zh: 所以计划是他弟弟胡安（Juan）率领50名骑兵发动进攻，他们将冲破敌阵，冲上山坡并夺取城堡。

sentences.en: It's a very kind of helms deep plan and there's a very helms deep scene to kick it all off.
sentences.zh: 这很像《指环王》里的圣盔谷之战，而且开场也很有圣盔谷的感觉。

sentences.en: So a later
sentences.zh: 所以后来的一份

sentences.en: Inca source says, the Spaniards spent the whole of that night on their knees with their hands clasped in prayer.
sentences.zh: 印卡史料记载，西班牙人整晚都跪在地上，双手合十祈祷。

sentences.en: Even those on guard in the square did the same as did many Indians who were on their side.
sentences.zh: 即使是广场上的守卫也这样做，许多站在他们那边的印第安人也一样。

sentences.en: On the following morning at dawn they emerged from the church and mounted their horses.
sentences.zh: 第二天黎明，他们走出教堂，骑上马。

sentences.en: Suddenly they put spur to their horses and at full gallop broke through the enemy and charged up the hillside at breakneck speed.
sentences.zh: 突然，他们策马扬鞭，全速冲破敌阵，以惊人的速度冲上山坡。

sentences.en: So very exciting.
sentences.zh: 真是太刺激了。

sentences.en: Stones and missiles are kind of raining down on them but they zigzag up the hill, they reach the terraces, they turn right at a village on the top of the hill and they finally
sentences.zh: 石头和投射物像雨点般落在他们身上，但他们呈之字形冲上山坡，到达梯田，在山顶的一个村庄右转，最终

sentences.en: end up in the parade ground in front of the citadel.
sentences.zh: 抵达了城堡前的阅兵场。

sentences.en: And here
sentences.zh: 在这里，

sentences.en: Incas have put up barricades but Juan Pizarro and his brother
sentences.zh: 印卡人设置了路障，但胡安·皮萨罗（Juan Pizarro）和他的弟弟

sentences.en: Gonzalo lead the horsemen in charge after charge.
sentences.zh: 贡萨洛（Gonzalo）率领骑兵一次又一次地冲锋。

sentences.en: Some of the horses are wounded, some of the Spaniards are thrown from the horses but they manage to break through the barricades and get all the way to the fortress gate.
sentences.zh: 有些马匹受伤了，有些西班牙人被甩下马，但他们还是设法冲破了路障，一直打到了堡垒大门。

sentences.en: Now, it's now late afternoon and they're knackered.
sentences.zh: 现在已经是傍晚了，他们精疲力竭。

sentences.en: The Incas are raiding down these kind of javelins and sling stones and stuff.
sentences.zh: 印卡人正投下那种标枪、投石索石块之类的东西。

sentences.en: Juan's page boy is killed by this huge stone.
sentences.zh: 胡安的侍从被一块巨石砸死了。

sentences.en: Juan Pizarro himself had been hit the day before by a slingshot missile and his face was so swollen that he couldn't wear his helmet.
sentences.zh: 胡安·皮萨罗本人前一天被投石索击中，脸肿得连头盔都戴不上。

sentences.en: Oh dear, unwise.
sentences.zh: 天哪，真不明智。

sentences.en: But he says to the Spaniards, one more attack before nightfall.
sentences.zh: 但他对西班牙人说，天黑前再发起一次进攻。

sentences.en: That's what it takes and they spur their horses.
sentences.zh: 这就是所需要的，他们催动马匹。

sentences.en: They race for the gate.
sentences.zh: 他们冲向大门。

sentences.en: Their missiles are raining down again.
sentences.zh: 投射物又像雨点般落下。

sentences.en: And then a massive stone smacks into
sentences.zh: 然后一块巨石猛地砸在

sentences.en: Juan Pizarro's head.
sentences.zh: 胡安·皮萨罗的头上。

sentences.en: Oh my god, so like an egg, a boiled egg being smashed.
sentences.zh: 天哪，就像一颗煮熟的鸡蛋被砸碎了一样。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He totters, he falls off his horse, he's clearly hideously wounded.
sentences.zh: 他摇摇晃晃，从马上摔了下来，显然受了重伤。

sentences.en: The Spanish break off their charge, they rush to his side and they carry him down the hill to Cusco.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人停止冲锋，冲到他身边，把他抬下山送往库斯科。

sentences.en: So he clings to life overnight and he dictates a will and he says, I leave all my plunder to my brother Gonzalo.
sentences.zh: 他熬过了一夜，口述了遗嘱，他说，我把我所有的战利品留给我的弟弟贡萨洛。

sentences.en: He leaves some money to religious bequests, he leaves some money to the poor but now he really lets himself down.
sentences.zh: 他留了一些钱做宗教捐赠，留了一些钱给穷人，但现在他真的让人失望了。

sentences.en: You may remember he had locked up this young girl who he was sleeping with who was a princess and he said, I leave nothing to her.
sentences.zh: 你可能记得他曾把那个与他同床共枕的年轻女孩关起来，她是一位公主，他说，我什么都不留给她。

sentences.en: I mean he actually said this, I mean what a bastard to say this as he's dying.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他竟然真的说了这话，作为一个垂死之人，真是个混蛋。

sentences.en: I leave nothing to her.
sentences.zh: 我什么都不留给她。

sentences.en: He called her an Indian woman who has given birth to a girl whom I do not recognise as my daughter.
sentences.zh: 他称她为一个印第安女人，生下了一个我不承认是我女儿的女孩。

sentences.en: As you say, an absolute bastard to the end
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，直到最后都是个彻头彻尾的混蛋。

sentences.en: Yeah, and then he died.
sentences.zh: 是啊，然后他就死了。

sentences.en: I mean, so unnecessary.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，太没必要了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: But he's a bad advert for Spain I think.
sentences.zh: 但我认为他是西班牙的一个反面教材。

sentences.en: So the next day
sentences.zh: 所以第二天，

sentences.en: Juan's devastated brother
sentences.zh: 胡安悲痛欲绝的弟弟

sentences.en: Gonzalo leads another assault.
sentences.zh: 贡萨洛领导了另一次突击。

sentences.en: Great drama.
sentences.zh: 太戏剧性了。

sentences.en: Everyone was shouting and they were all entangled together fighting for the hilltop.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在大喊大叫，他们纠缠在一起，为争夺山顶而战。

sentences.en: It looked as though the whole world was up there grappling in close combat.
sentences.zh: 看起来好像全世界的人都在上面进行肉搏战。

sentences.en: And as night's falling and Nando joins the assault he's spent the day making scaling ladders.
sentences.zh: 当夜幕降临时，南多（Nando）加入了突击，他花了一整天时间制作云梯。

sentences.en: Again, the kind of technology that the Incas don't really have but the Spanish of course are used to from their fighting in the old world.
sentences.zh: 同样，这是印卡人并不真正具备的技术，但西班牙人当然习惯了他们在旧世界的战斗。

sentences.en: And under this hail of stones the Spanish start to scale the outer walls.
sentences.zh: 在石雨中，西班牙人开始攀爬外墙。

sentences.en: Again, it is very helms deep.
sentences.zh: 再次重申，这非常像圣盔谷之战。

sentences.en: And then there's this ferocious hand-to-hand fighting as they drive the Incas back to the inner citadel.
sentences.zh: 随后发生了激烈的肉搏战，他们将印卡人逼回了内堡。

sentences.en: The fighting goes on for the next two days.
sentences.zh: 战斗持续了接下来的两天。

sentences.en: The commander of the citadel was a man called
sentences.zh: 城堡的指挥官是一个叫

sentences.en: Titucuzi Gualpa and he had sworn to fight to the death.
sentences.zh: 蒂图库齐·瓜尔帕（Titucuzi Gualpa）的人，他发誓要战斗到死。

sentences.en: He's hit twice by Spanish arrows but it doesn't deter him.
sentences.zh: 他两次被西班牙人的箭射中，但这并没有阻止他。

sentences.en: He strides around we're told like a lion from side to side of the tower.
sentences.zh: 我们被告知，他像狮子一样在塔楼两侧大步走动。

sentences.en: He repulsed any Spaniards who tried to mount with scaling ladders.
sentences.zh: 他击退了任何试图用云梯攀爬的西班牙人。

sentences.en: He killed any Indians who tried to surrender.
sentences.zh: 他杀死了任何试图投降的印第安人。

sentences.en: He smashed their heads with the battle axe he was carrying and hurled them from the top of the tower.
sentences.zh: 他用随身携带的战斧砸碎他们的头，并将他们从塔顶扔下去。

sentences.en: So basically like one of Stalin's commissars or something in the Second World War.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上就像二战中斯大林手下的政委之类的角色。

sentences.en: Basically if you falter he'll smash it over the head with an axe.
sentences.zh: 基本上如果你动摇了，他就会用斧头砸你的头。

sentences.en: I was thinking more like Gimli.
